name: std::numeric_limits<T>::has_signaling_NaN
intro: The value of std::numeric_limits<T>::has_signaling_NaN is true for all types T capable of representing the special value "Signaling Not-A-Number". This constant is meaningful for all floating-point types and is guaranteed to be true if std::numeric_limits<T>::is_iec559 == true.
